howToAdd: Append a capture whenever a transcript surfaces a new dismissal shape. Field transcripts are the source of truth: set source=field and the id to the transcript time (HH:MM). source=coverage entries exist to pin the word CLASS before a field capture arrives; when one does, add the field entry — never edit or delete the coverage one, so a regression in either shows up as a failure. The test reads every entry and asserts detectFeeNag against `expect` ('nag' or 'not-nag'). No code change is needed to add a capture.

captures.text: SKAPO E TOA . ZA SEKOJ STAN PO 300DEN
captures.why: The [23:12] field burst: calls the principle expensive and names the fee-sized amount; no viewing noun and no fee-object noun, so every noun arm missed it and the cheaper-search lane read it as a property budget.

captures.text: NE MI SE DOPAGJA VAKOV PRINCIP NA RABOTA
captures.why: The [23:12] practice disapproval — the deployed session answered it with rung 2's copy, so the ladder already owned it; the predicate must agree with the ladder.
The [23:11]/[23:12] charge question; before the fix the rent capture read it as the commission ask and jumped to contact collection without one rung.

captures.text: KAJ SE VIDELO PARI ZA OTVARANJE STAN
captures.why: The [22:03] rhetorical challenge — the field session answered it with the landmark rotation (a map pin for a place the client never asked about).
The fee-context hesitation family: everything that is not a POSITIVE climbs the planned order.

captures.text: SKUPO E TOA . ZA SEKOJ STAN PO 300DEN
captures.why: The standard скупо form beside the fee-sized figure; a Skopje client mixes скапо/скупо freely.
The dialect к- form of скапо. A token, not a stem: a 'куп' stem would swallow "kupiv stan".

captures.text: SCAPO E TOA . ZA SEKOJ STAN PO 300DEN
captures.why: The common c-for-k typing. normalizeMc maps c→ц, so the normalised string is 'сцапо' — the class is tested against the RAW text as well or this capture never fires.
Dismissal noun with productive inflection (бесмислица/бесмислено/бесмислени); anchored by the visit noun.

captures.text: APSURD E DA SE PLATI ZA POSETA
captures.why: Same family, the Latin-spelled form that normalizeMc maps to апсурд.
Moral dismissal (срамота/срамно/срамотен) — a value complaint, not a why-question.

captures.text: ова е чисто изнудување за посета
captures.why: Accusation noun (изнудување) about the fee; the charge-stem arm does not own it because no charge verb is present.
Dismissal phrase; normalises to 'нема логика'.
Worth dismissal — value complaint about the fee.
The dialect negator неќам (не сакам). This one was a CONSENT bug: the standalone 'платам' arm matched and the refusal ran as agreement — the negator class must own it.
Cyrillic и-form of the same negator.
A PURCHASE, not a fee. The value class must use the exact token 'купо', never a 'куп' stem.
A PROPERTY-price complaint: only the exact скапо/скупо token may fire the fee lane, never the 'скап' stem.
A value word with no visit/fee anchor is not fee traffic by itself.
Neutral amount question — the disclosure lane owns it.
Neutral why-question (leading why) — fee.why owns it, no rung burned.

captures.text: NE MOZAM DA PLATAM SO KARTICKA
captures.why: A bare negation is not the refusal family: only не сакам/нема да/неќам open the bare-refusal arm, or a payment-method line burns a rung.
Positive consent is never resistance.
